description: A shell script for testing various 'push.default' settings in Git, including setup, push operations, and workflow scenarios.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks that the latest commit in a given revision matches the expected commit in a specified repository.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Performs a push with specified 'push.default' value and verifies success.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Performs a push with specified 'push.default' value and verifies failure.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests different push workflows ('central' vs 'triangular') with various 'push.default' settings.
